text:
Zoe: Quick design review — compact rollout history scrubber + canary allocation affordance. Mock in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz. Looking for input on density, microcopy, and a11y announce behavior. Sam: Looks solid. Two quick q's: how do we surface 'active canary' vs a snapshot? And what's the hover state for the allocation chips? Marta: a11y nits: screen reader needs clear announcements on play/pause and when the scrubber jumps to a snapshot. Keyboard draggable handle needs role="slider" + aria-valuenow. Kevin: Implementation notes: role=slider is right. Also add an aria-live="polite" region for timeline position updates. Trap focus if the scrubber opens a modal. Zoe: Microcopy debate: 'Version timeline' vs 'Deployment history' — which reads clearer to users? Devon: Product voice: 'Deployment history' is clearer for non-dev PMs. Also rollback CTA wording: 'Revert to snapshot' vs 'Rollback to version' — I'd avoid 'rollback' alone. Sam: +1 'Deployment history'. For tiny screens the canary chip could show only a percent inside a small circle. Zoe: Trying to reduce visual noise — thinking collapsed mode where chips only expand on hover. Concern: hover-only interactions break keyboard/touch. Marta: Don't rely on hover-only. Hover can be enhancement but must be reachable via keyboard focus and touch. Make focus-visible identical to hover. Kevin: Small code sketch for aria and slider handling: ```html
Playback stopped at v3.4.1
``` Marta: Note on sr-only: use clip/clip-path offscreen technique, not display:none; otherwise AT won't read it. Zoe: Copy tweak suggestions: 'Start playback' -> 'Play timeline', 'Pause' -> 'Pause playback', and change 'Jump to version' -> 'Go to snapshot' maybe. Thoughts? Devon: Also add rollback impact modal: show estimated % of traffic affected, recent error rate delta, and an undo path. That reduces human error. Sam: UX nudge: show small safety-net banner when attempting to rollback an active canary with auto-routing enabled. Kevin: Perf note: don't render thousands of timestamp rows. Virtualize the timeline and render dense markers; expand on hover/focus. Deploy Bot: Accessibility screenshot check failed for timeline markers: contrast ratio 3.2:1 (needs 4.5:1). Marta: Thanks @Deploy Bot — consider darker stroke or filled markers for contrast. Also ensure focus ring is 3px with 3:1 contrast to background. Zoe: I'll update the Figma with keyboard state screenshots, include contrast values, and iterate on the collapsed layout. Will ping @Marta to verify SR announcements. Thanks everyone :thumbsup::party_parrot: Sam: +1, can we do a quick 15m sync tomorrow after you update? Zoe: Yep — scheduling now.
